site._comment_green: Main body text, navigation links, and primary borders.
site._comment_green-bright: Page headings, emphasized text, and text in form controls.
site._comment_green-dim: Subtle borders, dividers, and heading shadows.
site._comment_cyan: Links, focus outlines, and accent labels or borders.
site._comment_magenta: Hovered links and occasional secondary accents.
site._comment_red: Error or danger text and status indicators.
site._comment_white: Secondary body text and text on emphasized surfaces.
site._comment_black: Main page and dark panel background.
site._comment_field: Background of text inputs, textareas, and select controls.
site._comment_button: Background of buttons and button-like links.

masthead._comment_masthead: Colour of the large text logo at the top of the station.
masthead._comment_masthead-shadow: Offset shadow behind the large text logo.
